verdict.rationale: Docs confirm the SDK provides a programmatic interface to create sandboxes, run commands, and manage files, plus mounting remote storage and reading/writing files through the sandbox filesystem, implying file read/write support; however no explicit code samples or API references for upload/download methods (e.g. writeFiles/readFile calls) are shown. missing for 10: explicit SDK method documentation/examples for file upload and download operations, and independent/hands-on corroboration of file I/O behavior.
